text:
abby: Quick sync — microcost benchmark creative. We need: 1) a 1-line hook for launch posts, 2) three charts (cheap unit econ, tail latency, throughput vs $), 3) webinar framing copy, and 4) inbound routing + form fields. Ideas?

mike: Who's the primary audience? SMB dev teams or infra/platform?

abby: Primary: engineers at product-first startups + platform teams evaluating dedicated vs hosted. Secondary: mid-market infra buyers. Keep language engineer-forward but with one-sentence exec hook.

sarah: For charts: 1) tokens->$ waterfall (stacked bars by batching/cache), 2) 95/99 latency heatmap across seq lengths, 3) cost-per-1000-req scatter vs throughput. Short captions that surface the tradeoff.

dan: Data's ready for those slices — I can export CSVs. Quick chart skeleton:
```
chart1: waterfall, x=workload, y=$/1000 tokens, series=[base-token, batching-savings, cache-savings]
chart2: heatmap, x=seq_len, y=percentile, value=median-latency-ms
chart3: scatter, x=throughput-reqs/s, y=$/k-requests, color=model-family
```
Use simple axis labels, avoid jargon like "KV warmpath" in public copy.

violet: Design notes: recommend a three-panel hero (left: waterfall sparkline, middle: heatmap thumbnail, right: scatter preview). Palette: teal/indigo for perf, amber for cost highlights. Keep fonts bold for numeric callouts.

leo: Inbound routing: add a 2-question qualifier on demo form: 1) "Projected monthly QPS" (buckets), 2) "Primary deployment" (hosted/dedicated/private). Score leads: QPS>200k or "private" -> sales SDR route; otherwise growth flow + self-serve nurture. Add tag "benchmark_interest" for GA/Segment.

mike: Hook candidates: 
- "Same model. 3x cheaper inference. Here's how."
- "How we cut per-request spend without raising latency."
- "Latency you can pledge. Costs you can plan."
My vote: the 2nd one reads clear to engineers.

abby: Love the second. For social: shorten to "Cut inference spend. Keep latency."

sarah: Webinar framing: 30m total. 10m setup (why unit-econ matters), 12m demo of charts + live QPS scenario, 8m customer panel / Q&A. CTA: "See your numbers" — link to interactive calc (pre-fill QPS from form).

dan: I'll wire the CSV -> chart pipeline and hand you PNG + raw CSV by EOD. Can also expose a tiny API for the interactive calc.

leo: For routing, also add hidden utm tag: utm_campaign=microcost_bench_2026. Segment events: benchmark_clicked, calc_submitted, demo_requested.

violet: Microcopy options for CTAs: ["Run your estimate", "See your unit costs", "Book a quick ops review"]. Prefer shorter verbs.

abby: CTA shortlist: "Run your estimate" (primary), "Book ops review" (secondary). We'll A/B the hero CTA vs blog inline CTA.

mike: I'll draft hero lines + 150-word launch post this afternoon and ping for a quick edit pass.

sarah: Can we get the final visual + copy decisions by 12pm tomorrow? Need time to set up social cadence + ads.

abby: Timeline ack. Dan + Violet, deliverables by EOD. Mike drafts hero + post by 4pm. Leo will confirm routing tags and form schema. Sarah will schedule the webinar slot if we lock tomorrow.

emily-bot: Scheduled: "Microcost benchmark creative review" on 2026-03-24 10:00 AM PT. Invite pinned to #marketing.

abby: Perfect — thanks everyone. Small ask: keep public copy focused on tradeoffs (raw numbers) not internal architecture. We'll have an appendix for customers who want the deeper tech notes. :thumbsup:
